encounter.title: Act I Encounter 1 — Two-Front Stand (seed 22)
encounter.notes: ACT-I-001 playtest content (docs/ACT-I-FIRST-3-SHORTLIST.md §2). easy 6x7 seed 22 (11 arrows: N1 E4 S2 W4). Multi-enemy reinforcement. Grunt W (hp 2, ATTACK IN 3, dmg 2) on left flank; Grunt E (hp 3, ATTACK IN 5, dmg 2) on right flank. Shared RunState Rotate pool (2 charges available post-prologue). Proven clean path without Rotate: 0 damage in 5 taps (tap #0 -> tap #5 -> tap #6 -> tap #10 -> tap #9).
